description: This file contains utility classes and functions for compiling, running, and testing AOT (ahead-of-time) inductor models in PyTorch, including wrappers for models, compilation, loading, execution, and test helpers.

classes.name: WrapperModule
classes.description: A simple wrapper around a PyTorch module to facilitate model wrapping.

methods.name: legacy_compile( model, example_inputs, options=None, dynamic_shapes=None, disable_constraint_solver=False, )
methods.description: Compiles a model using legacy methods, returns a serialized shared object path.

methods.name: "AOTIModelContainerRunner" legacy_load_runner(device, so_path: str)
methods.description: Loads a model runner in the legacy environment based on device type in FBCODE.

methods.name: legacy_load(device, so_path)
methods.description: Loads a serialized model for inference in the legacy environment.

methods.name: legacy_run( device: str, model, example_inputs, options=None, dynamic_shapes=None, disable_constraint_solver=False, )
methods.description: Compiles and runs a model using legacy methods, returning the output.

methods.name: compile( model: Union[torch.nn.Module, types.FunctionType], example_inputs: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], inductor_configs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, dynamic_shapes: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], tuple[Any], list[Any]]] = None, )
methods.description: Compiles a model with optional inductor configs and dynamic shapes, returning a package path.

methods.name: run( model: Union[torch.nn.Module, types.FunctionType], example_inputs: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], inductor_configs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, dynamic_shapes: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], tuple[Any], list[Any]]] = None, )
methods.description: Compiles and runs a model, returning the output.

methods.name: run_multiple( model: Union[torch.nn.Module, types.FunctionType], list_example_inputs: list[tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]], inductor_configs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, dynamic_shapes: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], tuple[Any], list[Any]]] = None, )
methods.description: Runs a model multiple times with different inputs, returning a list of outputs.

methods.name: check_model( self: TestCase, model, example_inputs, options=None, dynamic_shapes=None, atol=None, rtol=None, move_model_to_device=True, )
methods.description: Checks the correctness of a model by comparing the compiled output to the original.

methods.name: check_model_with_multiple_inputs( self: TestCase, model, list_example_inputs, options=None, dynamic_shapes=None, )
methods.description: Checks model correctness over multiple input sets.

methods.name: code_check_count( self: TestCase, model, example_inputs, target_str: str, target_count: int, )
methods.description: Inspects the generated C++ code to count occurrences of a specific string.
